item.title: Houthis advance on Yemen government stronghold of Aden
item.description: Yemen’s Houthis were advancing on the interim seat of the internationally recognised government on Sunday, positioned just 60km from Aden, sources told Agence France-Presse, as government forces rushed to defend the city. Four military sources within government forces and two government sources said the Houthis had seized control of two districts in Lahj province and were moving towards Aden. They said the Houthis were positioned at the Al-Kharaz camp in Al-Madariba, 60km (about 40 miles) from... Publicado también por: Al Jazeera English. Fuente: South China Morning Post.
item.dc:creator: Agence France-Presse

item.title: Eisenkot says Netanyahu ‘cannot remain’ after alleged election interference by aide
item.description: Israeli prime ministerial hopeful Gadi Eisenkot said on Sunday caretaker premier Benjamin Netanyahu must leave office immediately following reports of alleged electoral interference by a Netanyahu aide. The former army chief called Netanyahu and his entourage an immediate threat to democracy, hours after representatives discussed forming a national unity government. Fuente: France 24 - English.

item.title: 'Perfectly safe' but not 'maxed out'? Trump takes Qatar jet to Asia
item.description: US President Donald Trump is set to travel to Asia on Monday aboard the aircraft gifted by Qatar, even as questions remain over its promised security upgrades. According to NBC News, the jet has received some maintenance and cosmetic improvements, but the larger overhaul remains unclear months after an Iran-related security scare forced Trump to fly home from Turkey on a secret military plane. Fuente: The Times of India - World.

item.title: Hutíes de Yemen avanzan hacia Adén y se acercan a su sede de gobierno provisional
item.description: Los rebeldes hutíes de Yemen se encuentran a solo 60 kilómetros de la ciudad de Adén, sede provisional del Ejecutivo yemení reconocido internacionalmente. Las fuerzas gubernamentales se retiraron de sus posiciones cercanas al estrecho de Bab el-Mandeb para, según sostienen, centrarse en la defensa de su principal base en Adén. Se trata de un duro revés para la ofensiva gubernamental, respaldada por Arabia Saudita, contra los hutíes, alineados con Irán. Fuente: France 24 - Español.
item.dc:creator: FRANCE24

item.title: 'Not Cuba or Venezuela': Iran warns it will not wait for US attack before responding
item.description: Iran has expressed that it is ready for potential military action while discussing diplomatic avenues with the United States. Deputy foreign minister Kazem Gharibabadi indicated three possible scenarios: diplomatic talks, economic blockades, and military response. Tehran has set specific conditions, including ending the war and lifting economic sanctions for any agreement. The arrival of the USS Theodore Roosevelt in the Middle East adds to ongoing regional tensions. Fuente: The Times of India - World.
item.dc:creator: Yashasvi Vasistha

item.title: Massie, el tormento republicano de Trump, se va dando guerra: recupera el escándalo Epstein y el conflicto de Irán
item.description: A Thomas Massie , el diputado republicano más combativo con Donald Trump, le quedan pocas semanas en Washington: con la formación del Congreso elegido en las pasadas 'midterms', tendrá que hacer las maletas. Trump se lo cargó en primarias: presentó y apoyó a un candidato rival, que le ha dejado sin escaño.Pero Massie ha dejado claro que se va a ir dando guerra a Trump, con movimientos legislativos para devolver a la atención pública los dos asuntos que más daño le han hecho al presidente: la guerra de Irán y el escándalo de Jeffrey Epstein. También ha forzado una votación para el… Fuente: ABC España - Internacional.
